verdict.evidence:
+def test_delete_removes_expense(tmp_path, capsys):
+    store = _store_path(tmp_path)
+    cli.main(["--store", store, "add", "50", "food", "--date", "2024-03-15"])
+    cli.main(["--store", store, "add", "30", "transport", "--date", "2024-03-16"])
+    capsys.readouterr()
+
+    rc = cli.main(["--store", store, "delete", "1"])
+    assert rc == 0
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "deleted #1" in out
+
+    with open(store) as fh:
+        data = json.load(fh)
+    ids = [e["id"] for e in data["expenses"]]
+    assert ids == [2]
+
+
+def test_delete_missing_id_returns_error(tmp_path, capsys):
+    store = _store_path(tmp_path)
+    rc = cli.main(["--store", store, "delete", "99"])
+    assert rc == 1
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "no expense with id 99" in out
